Sparkling Mango Mint Soda
By: Blackswan
Published: Monday, December 17, 2018 - 6:52pm

Ingredients




1 large Thai Golden Honey Mango
½ Thai Lime
2 sprigs Mint Leaves
2 canned Soda
8 tbsp Sugar Syrup (according to sweetness preference )
½ tray Ice Cubes

Preparation

1 Rinse mango and remove skin. Dice and add mango cubes into serving glasses. 2 Rinse mint leaves. Divide and throw into glasses. 3 Cut lime into wedges. Leave 4 for presentation, dice the rest and add into glasses. 4 Add sugar syrup, ice cubes and soda into glasses. Serve your Sparkling Mango Mint Soda immediately.

About

Infused with lime, mint leaves, and mango, this refreshing Spritzer makes a great Christmas thirst quencher!
